title: THE ALERT LANE IN THE SHOOTER VOICE
why: His order of 2026-10-09: a line the player reads in a raid is a short caps headline like Call of Duty, Fortnite or ARC Raiders, with a short detail only when needed, never an explaining sentence. The review of the third batch of raid text found details that still explained and three headlines that narrated. They now read as callouts: SIEGE INCOMING with About 6 machines inbound, a closing ring with the time it has left, EXTRACTION MISSED with Hold E to call again, the call with only its inbound time, a teammate call as his name then EXTRACT and the letter, HOST DISCONNECTED with You are hosting now, PILLAGER REINFORCEMENTS, SPOTTED BY SOMETHING HUGE, GRENADE HIT COVER with Get clear, and the in-ring hints in a few words. The inbound hint keeps its seconds.
now: Raid alerts read as short callouts: SIEGE INCOMING, EXTRACTION MISSED, HOST DISCONNECTED, PILLAGER REINFORCEMENTS and short details instead of sentences.
